question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Entire** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Entire **means the whole or complete extent of something, encompassing all its parts or elements. (किसी चीज़ का संपूर्ण या संपूर्ण विस्तार, जिसमें उसके सभी भाग या तत्व शामिल हों) • **Example**: *She read the entire book in one sitting, captivated by the compelling story from beginning to end.* • So, the use of "**entire**" in this context is appropriate for emphasizing the broad and all-encompassing nature of the term "society" when applied to a region, country, or the entire world. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Illiterate: **Unable to read or write; lacking basic literacy skills. (पढ़ने या लिखने में असमर्थ; बुनियादी साक्षरता कौशल का अभाव) • **Primitive: **Basic, rudimentary, or characteristic of an early stage of development; simple and unsophisticated. (विकास के प्रारंभिक चरण की बुनियादी, अल्पविकसित या विशेषता; सरल और अपरिष्कृत) • **Absolute: **Unconditional, complete, or not limited by any conditions; total and unrestricted. (बिना शर्त, पूर्ण, या किसी भी शर्त से सीमित नहीं; कुल और अप्रतिबंधित) 40:Tde2, The correct answer is: **Interdependence**
